title: The Dry Season in Tanzania
excerpt: The dry season, from June to October, is the classic safari time in Tanzania. Why wildlife viewing is easier, and what to expect.
body:
## Why the dry season

- Animals gather around rivers and waterholes.
- Short grass and thinner vegetation make spotting easier.
- Fewer mosquitoes.
- Clear skies.

## Where

- Tarangire: elephants.
- Northern Serengeti: river crossings.
- Ruaha and Nyerere: excellent.
- Katavi: spectacular.

## Weather

Sunny days, cold mornings and nights. Dusty.

## Busy

High season, especially July and August. See [July and August](/blog/tanzania-in-july-and-august/).

## Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar

Also at their best.

See [Tanzania weather by month](/blog/tanzania-weather-by-month/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
